units.zh: 曆象誌上
units.en: Celestial Phenomena Treatise I
units.literal: Celestial Phenomena Treatise, Part One

units.zh: 遼以幽、營立國，禮樂制度，規模日完，授歷頒朔二百餘年。
units.en: The Liao rose from You and Ying; as ritual and institutions matured, they issued calendars and set the new moon for over two hundred years.
units.literal: The Liao founded their state on You and Ying; rites, music, and institutions grew daily more complete, and for more than two hundred years they transmitted the calendar and issued the new moon.

units.zh: 今奉詔修遼史，體與宋、金似，其《大明曆》不可少也。
units.en: Ordered to compile the History of Liao on the model of the Song and Jin histories, we cannot omit the Great Brightness Calendar.
units.literal: Now, by imperial order we compile the History of Liao; its form resembles the Song and Jin histories, and the Great Brightness Calendar cannot be omitted.

units.zh: 歷書法禁不可得，求《大明曆》元，得祖沖之法於外史。
units.en: Official calendrical methods were barred from circulation; in seeking the Great Brightness epoch we found Zu Chongzhi's procedures in an outside history.
units.literal: The calendrical methods were forbidden and unobtainable; seeking the epoch of the Great Brightness Calendar, we obtained Zu Chongzhi's methods in an external history.

units.zh: 沖之之法，遼歷之所從出也歟？
units.en: Did the Liao calendar ultimately derive from Chongzhi's methods?
units.literal: Were Chongzhi's methods what the Liao calendar derived from?

units.zh: 國朝亦嘗因之。
units.en: The present dynasty too once adopted them.
units.literal: Our dynasty also once followed them.

units.zh: 以沖之法算，而至於遼更歷之年，以起元數，是蓋遼《大明曆》。
units.en: Working forward with Chongzhi's arithmetic to the Liao calendar reform and deriving the epoch from that point yields the Liao Great Brightness Calendar.
units.literal: Calculating by Chongzhi's methods up to the year the Liao revised the calendar, and taking the epoch count from that, this is the Liao Great Brightness Calendar.

units.zh: 遼歷因是固可補，然弗之補，史貴闕文也。
units.en: The Liao calendar could be reconstructed from this material, but we leave it unreconstructed, for histories prize deliberate gaps.
units.literal: The Liao calendar could indeed be supplemented on this basis, yet it is not supplemented; histories value lacunae in the text.

units.zh: 外史紀其法，司天存其職，《遼史》誌是足矣。
units.en: An outside history records the procedures, the Directorate of Astronomy keeps the office, and this treatise in the History of Liao is enough.
units.literal: The external history records its methods; the Directorate of Astronomy preserves its duties; for the History of Liao, this treatise suffices.

units.zh: 作《歷象志》。
units.en: Hence the Calendar and Celestial Phenomena Treatise.
units.literal: Thus the Calendar and Celestial Phenomena Treatise was composed.

units.zh: 歷
units.en: Calendar
units.literal: Calendar

units.zh: 大同元年，太宗皇帝自晉汴京收百司僚屬伎術歷象，遷於中京，遼始有歷。
units.en: In Datong year 1 (947), Emperor Taizong gathered officials, retainers, artisans, and calendrical specialists from the Jin capital Bianjing and moved them to the Central Capital, and the Liao first acquired a state calendar.
units.literal: In Datong year 1, Emperor Taizong collected the officials, retainers, craftsmen, and calendrical specialists from the Jin capital Bianjing and relocated them to the Central Capital; the Liao then first had a calendar.

units.zh: 先是，梁、唐仍用景福《崇玄曆》。
units.en: Earlier, Liang and Tang had continued using the Jingfu Chongxuan Calendar.
units.literal: Previously, Liang and Tang still used the Jingfu Chongxuan Calendar.

units.zh: 晉天福四年，司天監馬重績奏上《乙未元曆》，號《調元曆》，太宗所收天汴是也。
units.en: In Later Jin Tianfu year 4 (939), Director of Astronomy Ma Chongji presented the Yiwei Origin Calendar, titled the Tiaoyuan Calendar—the calendar Taizong had taken from Bianjing.
units.literal: In Jin Tianfu year 4, Director of Astronomy Ma Chongji submitted the Yiwei Origin Calendar, called the Tiaoyuan Calendar; this was what Taizong collected at Bian.

units.zh: 穆宗應歷十一年，司天王白、李正等進歷，蓋《乙未元曆》也。
units.en: In Muzong's Yingli year 11 (961), Wang Bai, Li Zheng, and others of the Directorate of Astronomy submitted a calendar that was essentially the Yiwei Origin Calendar.
units.literal: In Muzong Yingli year 11, Director of Astronomy Wang Bai, Li Zheng and others presented a calendar, essentially the Yiwei Origin Calendar.

units.zh: 聖宗統和十二年，可汗州刺史賈俊進新歷，則《大明曆》是也。
units.en: In Shengzong's Tonghe year 12 (994), Jia Jun, prefect of Kehanzhou, presented a new calendar—the Great Brightness Calendar.
units.literal: In Shengzong Tonghe year 12, Prefect Jia Jun of Kehanzhou presented a new calendar; this was the Great Brightness Calendar.

units.zh: 高麗所誌《大遼古今錄》稱統和十二年始頒正朔改歷，驗矣。
units.en: The Korean work Great Liao Ancient and Modern Accounts records that the new moon and calendar reform were first promulgated in Tonghe year 12—confirmed.
units.literal: The Korean record Great Liao Ancient and Modern Accounts states that in Tonghe year 12 the correct new moon and calendar reform were first issued; verified.

units.zh: 《大明曆》本宋祖沖之法，具見沈約《宋書》。
units.en: The Great Brightness Calendar ultimately derives from Zu Chongzhi's Song methods, as fully recorded in Shen Yue's Book of Song.
units.literal: The Great Brightness Calendar ultimately derives from Zu Chongzhi's methods of Song; fully seen in Shen Yue's Book of Song.

units.zh: 具如左。
units.en: The particulars follow below.
units.literal: The details are as on the left.

units.zh: 宋武帝大明六年，祖沖之上《甲子元曆》法，未及施用，因名《大明曆》。
units.en: In the sixth year of Emperor Wu of Song's Daming reign (462 CE), Zu Chongzhi presented the Jiazi Epoch Calendar methods; before adoption they were called the Great Brightness Calendar.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Emperor Wu of Song's Daming reign, Zu Chongzhi submitted the methods of the Jiazi Epoch Calendar, which had not yet been put into use; it was therefore named the Great Brightness Calendar.

units.zh: 上元甲子至宋大明七年癸卯，五萬一千九百三十九年算外。
units.en: From upper-origin jiazi to Song Daming year 7 (guimao) is 51,939 years beyond the epoch count.
units.literal: From the upper origin jiazi to the seventh year of Song Daming, guimao, is 51,939 years, outside the count.

units.zh: 推朔術：
units.en: Procedure to compute new moons:
units.literal: Procedure for computing new moons:

units.zh: 置入上元年數算外，以章月乘之，滿章歲為積月，不盡為閏餘。
units.en: Take the years since upper origin (outside the count), multiply by rule months, divide by rule years for accumulated months; the remainder is intercalary remainder.
units.literal: Set in the upper-origin year count, outside the count; multiply by rule months; when full of rule years it makes accumulated months; what does not fill is intercalary remainder.

units.zh: 閏餘二百四十七以上，其年有閏。
units.en: If intercalary remainder is 247 or above, the year has a leap month.
units.literal: When intercalary remainder is 247 or more, that year has an intercalation.

units.zh: 以月法乘積月，滿日法為積日，不盡為小餘。
units.en: Multiply accumulated months by the month factor; divide by the day factor for accumulated days; the remainder is fractional day remainder (xiao yu).
units.literal: Multiply accumulated months by the month factor; when full of the day factor it makes accumulated days; what does not fill is small remainder.

units.zh: 六旬去積日，不盡為大餘。
units.en: Subtract full sixty-day cycles from accumulated days; the remainder is greater remainder (da yu).
units.literal: Remove six decades from accumulated days; what does not fill is greater remainder.

units.zh: 大餘命以甲子，算外，所求年天正十一月朔也。
units.en: Count greater remainder from jiazi (outside the count) to obtain the new moon of civil month 11 for the target year.
units.literal: Name greater remainder from jiazi, outside the count: that is the new moon of the eleventh month of the civil year sought.

units.zh: 小餘千八百四十九以上，其月大。
units.en: If fractional day remainder is 1,849 or more, the month is a long month (30 days).
units.literal: When small remainder is 1,849 or more, that month is long (thirty days).

units.zh: 求次月：
units.en: To find the next month:
units.literal: To seek the next month:

units.zh: 加大餘二十九，小餘二千九十。
units.en: Add 29 to greater remainder and 2,090 to fractional day remainder.
units.literal: Add to greater remainder 29; to small remainder 2,090.

units.zh: 小餘滿日法從大餘，大餘滿六旬去之，命如前，次月朔也。
units.en: When fractional remainder fills the day factor, carry to greater remainder; when greater remainder fills sixty days, drop it and name as before for the next new moon.
units.literal: When small remainder fills the day factor, carry to greater remainder; when greater remainder fills six decades, remove it; name as before: the next month's new moon.

units.zh: 求弦望：
units.en: To find first quarter and full moon:
units.literal: To seek first and full moon:

units.zh: 加朔大餘七，小餘千五百七，小分一。
units.en: Add 7 to new-moon greater remainder, 1,507 to small remainder, and 1 to small parts.
units.literal: Add to new-moon greater remainder 7; to small remainder 1,507; to small parts 1.

units.zh: 小分滿四從小餘，小餘滿日法從大餘，命如前，上弦日也。
units.en: When small parts reach 4, carry to small remainder; when small remainder fills the day factor, carry to greater remainder; name as before for first quarter.
units.literal: When small parts fill 4, carry to small remainder; when small remainder fills the day factor, carry to greater remainder; name as before: the first-quarter day.

units.zh: 又加得望，又加得下弦，又加得後月朔也。
units.en: Add again for full moon, again for last quarter, and again for the following new moon.
units.literal: Add again to obtain full moon; add again for last quarter; add again for the next month's new moon.

units.zh: 推閏術：
units.en: Procedure for computing intercalation:
units.literal: Procedure for computing intercalation:

units.zh: 以閏餘減章歲，余滿閏法得一月，命以天正，算外，閏所在也。
units.en: Subtract intercalary remainder from rule years; each time the remainder fills the intercalation factor you gain one month; count from civil new year (outside the count) to locate the leap month.
units.literal: Subtract intercalary remainder from rule years; when the remainder fills the intercalation factor, obtain one month; name from the civil new year, outside the count: where the intercalation lies.

units.zh: 閏有進退，以無中氣為正。
units.en: Leap placement may shift; the rule is that a month without a mid-climate is intercalary.
units.literal: Intercalations may advance or retreat; lack of a mid-climate is the standard.

units.zh: 推二十四氣：
units.en: Procedure to compute the twenty-four qi:
units.literal: Procedure for computing the twenty-four qi:

units.zh: 置入上元年數算外，以餘數乘之，滿紀法為積日，不盡為小餘。
units.en: Take years since upper origin (outside the count), multiply by remainder number, divide by era factor for accumulated days; the remainder is fractional day remainder.
units.literal: Set in the upper-origin year count, outside the count; multiply by remainder number; when full of era factor it makes accumulated days; what does not fill is small remainder.

units.zh: 六旬去積日，不盡為大餘。
units.en: Subtract sixty-day cycles from accumulated days; the remainder is greater remainder.
units.literal: Remove six decades from accumulated days; what does not fill is greater remainder.

units.zh: 大餘命以甲子，算外，天正十一月冬至日也。
units.en: Name greater remainder from jiazi (outside the count) for the winter solstice of civil month 11.
units.literal: Name greater remainder from jiazi, outside the count: the winter solstice day of the eleventh civil month.

units.zh: 求次氣：
units.en: To find the next qi:
units.literal: To seek the next qi:

units.zh: 加大餘十五，小餘八千六百二十六，小分五。
units.en: Add 15 to greater remainder, 8,626 to small remainder, and 5 to small parts.
units.literal: Add to greater remainder 15; to small remainder 8,626; to small parts 5.

units.zh: 小分滿六從小餘，小餘滿紀法從大餘，命如前，次氣日也。
units.en: When small parts reach 6, carry to small remainder; when small remainder fills era factor, carry to greater remainder; name as before for the next qi.
units.literal: When small parts fill 6, carry to small remainder; when small remainder fills era factor, carry to greater remainder; name as before: the next qi day.

units.zh: 求土王用事：
units.en: To find the earth phase (tu wang) period:
units.literal: To seek the earth's kingly tenure:

units.zh: 加冬至大餘二十七，小餘萬五千五百二十八，季冬土用事日也。
units.en: Add 27 to winter-solstice greater remainder and 15,528 to small remainder for the late-winter earth tenure day.
units.literal: Add to winter-solstice greater remainder 27; to small remainder 15,528: the last month of winter when earth holds sway.

units.zh: 又加大餘九十一，小餘萬二千二百七十，次土用事日也。
units.en: Add again 91 to greater remainder and 12,270 to small remainder for the next earth tenure day.
units.literal: Again add to greater remainder 91; to small remainder 12,270: the next earth tenure day.

units.zh: 推沒術：
units.en: Procedure for computing submergence (mo):
units.literal: Procedure for computing submergence:

units.zh: 以九十乘冬至小餘，以減沒分，滿沒法為日，不盡為日餘，命日以冬至，算外，沒日也。
units.en: Multiply winter-solstice fractional remainder by 90, subtract from submergence parts; divide by submergence factor for days; the remainder is day remainder; count from winter solstice (outside the count) for the submergence day.
units.literal: Multiply winter-solstice small remainder by 90; subtract from submergence parts; when full of submergence factor it makes days; what does not fill is day remainder; name the day from winter solstice, outside the count: the submergence day.

units.zh: 求次沒：
units.en: To find the next submergence:
units.literal: To seek the next submergence:

units.zh: 加日六十九，日餘三萬四千四百四十二，余滿沒法從日，次沒日也。
units.en: Add 69 days and 34,442 to day remainder; when remainder fills submergence factor, carry to days for the next submergence.
units.literal: Add days 69; day remainder 34,442; when remainder fills submergence factor, carry to days: the next submergence day.

units.zh: 日餘盡為滅。
units.en: When day remainder is exhausted, the cycle ends (mie).
units.literal: When day remainder is exhausted, it is extinguished.

units.zh: 推日所在度術：
units.en: Procedure for the sun's daily lodge:
units.literal: Procedure for the sun's lodge at each day:

units.zh: 以紀法乘朔積日為度實，周天去之，余滿紀法為積度，不盡為度餘。
units.en: Multiply new-moon accumulated days by era factor for degree dividend; subtract circumference of heaven; quotient by era factor gives accumulated degrees; remainder is degree remainder.
units.literal: Multiply new-moon accumulated days by era factor to make degree dividend; remove circumference of heaven; when remainder fills era factor it makes accumulated degrees; what does not fill is degree remainder.

units.zh: 命以虛一，次宿除之，算外，天正十一月朔夜半日所在度也。
units.en: Name from lodge Void I, subtract successive lodges (outside the count) for the sun's lodge at midnight on month-11 new moon.
units.literal: Name from Void I; remove lodges in sequence, outside the count: the sun's lodge at midnight on the eleventh-month new moon.

units.zh: 求次月：
units.en: To find the next month:
units.literal: To seek the next month:

units.zh: 大月加度三十，小月加度二十九，入虛去度分。
units.en: Add 30 degrees for a long month, 29 for a short month; when entering Void, subtract degree parts.
units.literal: Long month: add 30 degrees; short month: add 29 degrees; when entering Void, remove degree parts.

units.zh: 求行分：
units.en: To find motion parts:
units.literal: To seek motion parts:

units.zh: 以小分法除度餘，所得為行分，不盡為小分，小分滿法從行分，行分滿法從度。
units.en: Divide degree remainder by small-part factor for motion parts; the remainder is small parts; carry when parts fill their factors.
units.literal: Divide degree remainder by small-part factor; the obtained is motion parts; what does not fill is small parts; when small parts fill the factor, carry to motion parts; when motion parts fill the factor, carry to degrees.

units.zh: 求次日：加一度。
units.en: For the next day: add one degree.
units.literal: To seek the next day: add one degree.

units.zh: 入虛去行分六，小分百四十七。
units.en: On entering Void, subtract 6 motion parts and 147 small parts.
units.literal: When entering Void, remove motion parts 6 and small parts 147.

units.zh: 推月所在度術：
units.en: Procedure for the moon's lodge:
units.literal: Procedure for the moon's lodge at each time:

units.zh: 以朔小餘乘百二十四為度餘，又以朔小餘乘八百六十為微分，微分滿月法從度餘，度餘滿紀法為度。
units.en: Multiply new-moon fractional remainder by 124 for degree remainder and by 860 for minute parts; carry minute parts into degree remainder, then degree remainder into degrees by era factor.
units.literal: Multiply new-moon small remainder by 124 to make degree remainder; again multiply new-moon small remainder by 860 for minute parts; when minute parts fill month factor, carry to degree remainder; when degree remainder fills era factor, it makes degrees.

units.zh: 以減朔夜半日所在，則月所在度。
units.en: Subtract this from the new-moon midnight solar position to obtain the moon's lodge.
units.literal: Subtract from the new-moon midnight solar lodge: then the moon's lodge.

units.zh: 求次月：
units.en: To find the next month:
units.literal: To seek the next month:

units.zh: 大月加度三十五，度餘三萬一千八百三十四，微分七萬七千九百六十七，小月加度二十二，度餘萬七千二百六十一，微分六萬二千七百三十六，入虛去度也。
units.en: Long month: add 35 degrees plus the listed remainders and minute parts; short month: add 22 degrees plus its listed parts; on entering Void, subtract degrees.
units.literal: Long month: add 35 degrees, degree remainder 31,834, minute parts 77,967; short month: add 22 degrees, degree remainder 17,261, minute parts 62,736; when entering Void, remove degrees.

units.zh: 以通法乘朔積日為通實，通周去之，余滿通法為日，不盡為日餘。
units.en: Multiply new-moon accumulated days by communication factor for communication dividend; subtract communication cycle; divide by communication factor for days; remainder is day remainder.
units.literal: Multiply new-moon accumulated days by communication factor to make communication dividend; remove communication cycle; when remainder fills communication factor it makes days; what does not fill is day remainder.

units.zh: 命日算外，天正十一月朔夜半入歷日也。
units.en: Name the day (outside the count) for midnight entry into the sequence on month-11 new moon.

units.zh: 大月加二日，小月加一日，日餘皆萬一千七百四十六。

units.literal: Long month: add 2 days; short month: add 1 day; day remainder in each case 11,746.

units.zh: 歷滿二十七日，日餘萬四千六百三十一，則去之。
units.en: When the sequence reaches 27 days with day remainder 14,631, drop that cycle.
units.literal: When the sequence fills 27 days and day remainder 14,631, then remove it.

units.zh: 求次日：加一日。
units.en: For the next day: add one day.

units.literal: To seek the sun's fixed lodge at each day:

units.zh: 以夜半入歷日餘乘損益率，以損益盈縮積分，如差率而一，所得滿紀法為度，不盡為度餘，以盈加縮減平行度及余為定度。
units.en: Multiply midnight sequence day remainder by the adjustment rate, apply surplus-deficit to accumulated parts, scale by difference rate; divide by era factor for degrees; add surplus or subtract deficit from mean solar degree for true position.
units.literal: Multiply midnight sequence-entry day remainder by decrease-increase rate; by decrease-increase, adjust the accumulated surplus-deficit parts; as difference rate to one; when obtained fills era factor it makes degrees; what does not fill is degree remainder; add surplus and subtract deficit from mean degree and remainder for fixed degree.

units.zh: 益之或滿法，損之或不足，以紀法進退。
units.en: If increase overflows the factor or decrease underflows, adjust by one era factor.
units.literal: When increasing fills the factor, or decreasing is insufficient, advance or retreat by era factor.

units.zh: 求度行分如上法。
units.en: Find degree motion parts by the same method.
units.literal: To seek degree motion parts, use the procedure above.

units.zh: 求次日，如所入遲疾加之。
units.en: For the next day, add according to whether the sequence entry is slow or fast.
units.literal: To seek the next day, add according to the slow or fast entered.

units.zh: 虛去分，如上法。
units.en: On entering Void, subtract parts as above.
units.literal: When entering Void, remove parts as in the procedure above.

units.zh: 推入陰陽歷術：置通實以會周去之，不滿交數三十五萬八千八百八十八半為朔入陽歷分，各去之，為朔入陰歷分，各滿通法得一日，不盡為日餘。
units.en: To enter the Yin-Yang sequence: take communication dividend, subtract conjunction cycle; remainder under conjunction number 358,888.5 is yang-sequence entry for the new moon; subtract each portion for yin entry; divide by communication factor for days; remainder is day remainder.
units.literal: Procedure for entering the Yin-Yang sequence: set communication dividend; remove conjunction cycle; when not full of conjunction number 358,888.5 it is new-moon entry into yang sequence parts; remove each in turn for new-moon entry into yin sequence parts; when each fills communication factor obtain one day; what does not fill is day remainder.

units.zh: 命日算外，天正十一月朔夜半入歷日也。
units.en: Name the day (outside the count) for midnight sequence entry on month-11 new moon.
units.literal: Name the day, outside the count: the day entered in the sequence at midnight on the eleventh-month new moon.

units.zh: 求次月：大月加二日，小月加一日，日餘皆二萬七百七十九。
units.en: To find the next month: long month add 2 days; short month add 1 day; day remainder always 20,779.
units.literal: To seek the next month: long month add 2 days; short month add 1 day; day remainder in each case 20,779.

units.zh: 歷滿十三日，日餘萬五千九百八十七半，則去之。
units.en: When the sequence reaches 13 days with day remainder 15,987.5, drop that cycle.
units.literal: When the sequence fills 13 days and day remainder 15,987.5, then remove it.

units.zh: 陽竟入陰，陰竟入陽。
units.en: At yang's end one enters yin; at yin's end one enters yang.
units.literal: When yang ends, enter yin; when yin ends, enter yang.

units.zh: 求次日：加一日。
units.en: For the next day: add one day.
units.literal: To seek the next day: add one day.

units.zh: 求朔望差：以二千二十九乘朔小餘，滿三百三為日餘，不盡倍之為小分，則朔差數也。
units.en: For new/full moon correction: multiply new-moon fractional remainder by 2,029; divide by 303 for day remainder; double the remainder for small parts to get new-moon difference.
units.literal: To seek new- and full-moon difference: multiply new-moon small remainder by 2,029; when full of 303 it makes day remainder; what does not fill, double it for small parts: that is new-moon difference number.

units.zh: 加一十四日，日餘二萬一百八十六，小分百二十五。
units.en: Add 14 days, day remainder 20,186, and small parts 125.
units.literal: Add 14 days; day remainder 20,186; small parts 125.

units.zh: 小分滿六百六從日餘，日餘滿通法為日，即望差數也。
units.en: When small parts reach 606, carry to day remainder; when day remainder fills communication factor, convert to days for full-moon difference.
units.literal: When small parts fill 606, carry to day remainder; when day remainder fills communication factor, it makes days: that is full-moon difference number.

units.zh: 又加之，後月朔也。
units.en: Add again for the following new moon.
units.literal: Add again for the next month's new moon.

units.zh: 求合朔月食：置朔望夜半入陰陽歷及余，有半者去之，置小分三百三，以差數加之。
units.en: For conjunction and eclipse: take midnight yin-yang sequence entry and remainder at new/full moon, drop halves, set small parts 303, and add the difference number.
units.literal: To seek conjunction and lunar eclipse: set new- and full-moon midnight yin-yang sequence entry and remainder; when there is a half, remove it; set small parts 303; add the difference number.

units.zh: 小分滿六百六從日餘，日餘滿通法從日，日滿一歷去之。
units.en: Carry small parts into day remainder and day remainder into days; when days complete one sequence, subtract the cycle.
units.literal: When small parts fill 606, carry to day remainder; when day remainder fills communication factor, carry to days; when days fill one sequence, remove it.

units.zh: 命日算外，則朔望加時入歷也。
units.en: Name the day (outside the count) for sequence entry at the instant of new or full moon.
units.literal: Name the day, outside the count: then the sequence entry at the hour of new or full moon.

units.zh: 朔望加時入歷一日，日餘四千一百九十八，小分四百二十八以下，十二日，日餘萬一千七百八十八，小分四百八十一以上，朔則交會，望則月食。
units.en: If hour-entry is 1 day with remainder ≤4,198 and small parts ≤428, or 12 days with remainder ≥11,788 and small parts ≥481, new moon yields conjunction and full moon yields eclipse.
units.literal: When new- or full-moon hour sequence entry is one day and day remainder 4,198 with small parts 428 or below, or twelve days with day remainder 11,788 and small parts 481 or above, at new moon there is conjunction; at full moon, lunar eclipse.

units.zh: 求合朔月食定大小餘：令差數日餘加夜半入遲疾歷余，日餘滿通法從日，則朔望加時入歷也。
units.en: For fixed remainders at conjunction/eclipse: add difference day remainder to midnight slow-fast remainder; carry into days when remainder fills communication factor.
units.literal: To seek the fixed greater and smaller remainders for conjunction and eclipse: let difference-number day remainder add to midnight slow-fast sequence remainder; when day remainder fills communication factor, carry to days: then sequence entry at the hour of new or full moon.

units.zh: 以入歷余乘損益率，以損益盈縮積分，如差法而一，以盈減縮加本朔望小餘為定小餘。
units.en: Multiply sequence remainder by adjustment rate, adjust surplus-deficit parts, scale by difference factor, then subtract surplus or add deficit from base new/full fractional remainder.
units.literal: Multiply sequence-entry remainder by decrease-increase rate; by decrease-increase adjust accumulated surplus-deficit parts; as difference factor to one; subtract surplus and add deficit from the original new/full small remainder for fixed small remainder.

units.zh: 益之或滿法，損之或不足，以日法進退日。
units.en: On overflow or underflow in adjustment, carry or borrow using the day factor.
units.literal: When increasing fills the factor or decreasing is insufficient, advance or retreat by the day factor.

units.zh: 求合朔月食加時：以十二乘定小餘，滿日法得一辰，命以子，算外，加時所在辰也。
units.en: For event hour: multiply fixed fractional remainder by 12, divide by day factor for double-hours; count from zi (outside the count).
units.literal: To seek the hour of conjunction and eclipse: multiply fixed small remainder by 12; when full of day factor obtain one double-hour; name from zi, outside the count: the double-hour of the event.

units.zh: 有餘者四之，滿日法得一為少，二為半，三為太。
units.en: If remainder remains, multiply by four; each day-factor quotient gives minor (shao), half (ban), or major (tai) subdivisions.
units.literal: When there is remainder, quadruple it; when full of day factor obtain one as minor, two as half, three as major.

units.zh: 又有餘者三之，滿日法得一為強，以強並少為少強，並半為半強，並太為太強。
units.en: Further remainder: multiply by three; quotients are strong (qiang); combine with prior subdivisions for compound labels.
units.literal: When there is still remainder, triple it; when full of day factor obtain one as strong; combine strong with minor for minor-strong, with half for half-strong, with major for major-strong.

units.zh: 得二者為少弱，以並少為半弱，並半為太弱，並太為一辰弱，以前辰名之。
units.en: Two quotients yield minor-weak; combine upward through half-weak and major-weak to a full weak double-hour named from the prior hour.
units.literal: When two are obtained, that is minor-weak; combine with minor for half-weak, with half for major-weak, with major for one double-hour weak; name by the preceding double-hour.

units.zh: 求月去日道度：置入陰陽歷余乘損益率，如通法而一，以損益兼數為定。
units.en: For lunar latitude: take yin-yang sequence remainder, multiply by adjustment rate, divide by communication factor, and adjust the combined number.
units.literal: To seek the moon's degrees from the solar path: set yin-yang sequence remainder, multiply by decrease-increase rate, as communication factor to one, by decrease-increase adjust the combined number for the fixed value.

units.zh: 定數十二而一為度。
units.en: Divide the fixed number by twelve for degrees.
units.literal: Fixed number: twelve to one makes degrees.

units.zh: 不盡四而一，為少、半、太。
units.en: The remainder in quarters yields minor, half, and major subdivisions.
units.literal: What does not fill: four to one makes minor, half, and major.

units.zh: 又不盡者三而一，一為強，二為少弱，則月去日道數也。
units.en: Further remainder in thirds: one gives strong, two minor-weak, completing lunar distance from the ecliptic.
units.literal: When still not filled, three to one: one is strong, two is minor-weak: that is the moon's degrees from the solar path.

units.zh: 陽歷在表，陰歷在裏。
units.en: Yang sequence is outside the path; yin sequence inside.
units.literal: Yang sequence is outside; yin sequence is inside.

units.zh: 推五星術：置度實各以率去之，余以減率，其餘，如紀法而一，為入歲日，不盡為日餘，命以天正朔，算外，星合日。
units.en: For each planet: take degree dividend, subtract its rate repeatedly; treat the remainder over era factor as days since civil new-year new moon (outside the count) for conjunction day.
units.literal: Procedure for the five planets: set degree dividend; each remove its rate; from the remainder subtract the rate; the remainder, as era factor to one, is days entered in the year; what does not fill is day remainder; name from the civil new-year new moon, outside the count: day of planetary conjunction.

units.zh: 求星合度：以入歲日及余從天正朔日積度及余，滿紀法從度，滿三百六十餘度分則去之，命以虛一，算外，星合所在度也。
units.en: For conjunction degree: add year-entry days and remainder to new-year solar accumulated degrees; carry at era factor; drop full circles; name from Void I (outside the count).
units.literal: To seek the degree of conjunction: with days and remainder entered in the year, follow from civil new-year new-moon accumulated degrees and remainder; when remainder fills era factor, carry to degrees; when degrees fill 360, remove degree parts; name from Void I, outside the count: the degree where the planet conjoins.

units.zh: 求星日見：以術伏日及余加星合日及余，余滿紀法從日，命如前，見日也。
units.en: For first visibility: add tabulated morning/evening concealment days and remainder to conjunction; carry remainder into days; name as before.
units.literal: To seek the day of planetary appearance: add the computed concealment days and remainder to conjunction day and remainder; when remainder fills era factor, carry to days; name as before: day of appearance.

units.zh: 求星見度：以術伏度及余加星合度及余，余滿紀法從度，入虛去度分，命如前，星見度也。
units.en: For appearance degree: add concealment degrees and remainder to conjunction position; carry; subtract on entering Void; name as before.
units.literal: To seek the degree of appearance: add computed concealment degrees and remainder to conjunction degree and remainder; when remainder fills era factor, carry to degrees; when entering Void, remove degree parts; name as before: degree of appearance.

units.zh: 行五星法：以小分法除度餘，所得為行分，不盡為小分，及日加所行分，滿法從度，留者因前，逆則減之，伏不盡度。
units.en: Planetary motion: convert degree remainder to motion and small parts; add daily motion; carry at factor; hold in station, subtract in retrograde; concealment may leave degrees unused.
units.literal: Procedure for planetary motion: divide degree remainder by small-part factor; the obtained is motion parts; what does not fill is small parts; daily add the motion parts; when full of factor, carry to degrees; when stationary, follow the prior; when retrograde, subtract; when concealed, do not exhaust degrees.

units.zh: 從行入虛，去行分六，小分百四十七，逆往出虛，則加之。
units.en: On direct motion entering Void, subtract 6 motion parts and 147 small parts; add them when retrograde leaves Void.
units.literal: When direct motion enters Void, remove motion parts 6 and small parts 147; when retrograde emerges from Void, then add them.

units.zh: 初與日合，伏，十七日，日餘千三百七十八，行一度，度餘萬九千三百三十三，晨見東方，行順，日行二分，八十四日行七度七分。
units.en: First conjunction: 17 days concealed (remainder 1,378), 1 degree motion (remainder 19,333), morning east; then direct at two parts per day, 84 days for 7 degrees 7 parts.
units.literal: At first in conjunction with the sun, concealed 17 days, day remainder 1,378, moving 1 degree, degree remainder 19,333, morning appearance in the east; direct motion, daily two parts; in 84 days moves 7 degrees 7 parts.

units.zh: 留，三十三日。
units.en: Stationary 33 days.
units.literal: Stationary, 33 days.

units.zh: 行逆，日行一分，百一十日退四度十八分。
units.en: Retrograde one part per day; 110 days, retreat 4 degrees 18 parts.
units.literal: Retrograde, daily one part; in 110 days retreats 4 degrees 18 parts.

units.zh: 又留，三十三日。
units.en: Stationary again 33 days.
units.literal: Again stationary, 33 days.

units.zh: 從，日行二分，八十四日，夕伏西方，日度餘如初。
units.en: Prograde two parts per day for 84 days; evening concealment west with initial remainders.
units.literal: Prograde, daily two parts; 84 days; evening concealment in the west; day and degree remainder as at first.

units.zh: 一終三百七十八日，日餘二千七百五十六，行十二度，度餘三萬一千七百九十八。
units.en: One cycle: 378 days (remainder 2,756), motion 12 degrees (remainder 31,798).
units.literal: One cycle 378 days, day remainder 2,756, motion 12 degrees, degree remainder 31,798.

units.zh: 金星：
units.en: Venus:
units.literal: Venus:

units.zh: 初與日合，伏，三十九日，日餘三萬八千一百二十六，行四十九度，度餘三萬八千一百二十六，夕見西方。
units.en: First conjunction: 39 days concealed (remainder 38,126), motion 49 degrees (same remainder), evening visibility west.
units.literal: At first in conjunction with the sun, concealed 39 days, day remainder 38,126, moving 49 degrees, degree remainder 38,126, evening appearance in the west.

units.zh: 從，疾，日行一度五分，九十二日行百十二度。
units.en: Prograde fast: 1 degree 5 parts per day; 92 days, 112 degrees.
units.literal: Prograde, fast, daily one degree five parts; in 92 days moves 112 degrees.

units.zh: 小遲，日行一度四分，九十二日行百八度。
units.en: Slightly slow: 1 degree 4 parts per day; 92 days, 108 degrees.
units.literal: Slightly slow, daily one degree four parts; in 92 days moves 108 degrees.

units.zh: 大遲，日行十七分，四十五日行三十三度六分。
units.en: Very slow: seventeen parts per day; 45 days, 33 degrees 6 parts.
units.literal: Very slow, daily seventeen parts; in 45 days moves 33 degrees 6 parts.

units.zh: 留，九日。
units.en: Stationary 9 days.
units.literal: Stationary, 9 days.

units.zh: 遲，日行十六分，九日退六度六分，夕伏西方。
units.en: Slow retrograde: sixteen parts per day; 9 days, retreat 6 degrees 6 parts; evening concealment west.
units.literal: Slow, daily sixteen parts; in 9 days retreats 6 degrees 6 parts; evening concealment in the west.

units.zh: 伏五日，退五度，而與日合。
units.en: Concealed 5 days, retreat 5 degrees, then conjunction with the sun.
units.literal: Concealed 5 days, retreats 5 degrees, then in conjunction with the sun.

units.zh: 又五日退五度，而晨見東方，逆，日行十六分，九日，留，九日。
units.en: Another 5 days retreat 5 degrees, morning east; retrograde sixteen parts per day for 9 days; stationary 9 days.
units.literal: Again 5 days retreat 5 degrees, then morning appearance in the east; retrograde, daily sixteen parts; 9 days; stationary, 9 days.

units.zh: 從，遲，日行十七分，四十五日。
units.en: Prograde slow: seventeen parts per day for 45 days.
units.literal: Prograde, slow, daily seventeen parts; 45 days.

units.zh: 小疾，日行一度四分，九十二日。
units.en: Slightly fast: 1 degree 4 parts per day for 92 days.
units.literal: Slightly fast, daily one degree four parts; 92 days.

units.zh: 大疾，日行一度五分，九十二日。
units.en: Very fast: 1 degree 5 parts per day for 92 days.
units.literal: Very fast, daily one degree five parts; 92 days.

units.zh: 晨伏東方，日度餘如初。
units.en: Morning concealment east; day and degree remainders as at first.
units.literal: Morning concealment in the east; day and degree remainder as at first.

units.zh: 一終五百八十三日，日餘三萬六千七百六十一，行星如之。
units.en: One cycle: 583 days (remainder 36,761); planetary motion matches.
units.literal: One cycle 583 days, day remainder 36,761; planetary motion the same.

units.zh: 除一周，定行二百十八度，度餘二萬六千三百一十三。
units.en: Subtract one circuit; net motion 218 degrees (remainder 26,313).
units.literal: Remove one circuit; fixed motion 218 degrees, degree remainder 26,313.

units.zh: 合二百九十一日，日餘三萬八千一百二十六，行星亦如之。
units.en: Conjunction half-cycle: 291 days (remainder 38,126); motion likewise.
units.literal: Conjunction 291 days, day remainder 38,126; planetary motion likewise.

units.zh: 水星：
units.en: Mercury:
units.literal: Mercury:

units.zh: 初與日合，伏，十四日，日餘三萬七千一百一十五，行三十度，度餘三萬七千一百一十五，夕見西方。
units.en: First conjunction: 14 days concealed (remainder 37,115), motion 30 degrees (same remainder), evening west.
units.literal: At first in conjunction with the sun, concealed 14 days, day remainder 37,115, moving 30 degrees, degree remainder 37,115, evening appearance in the west.

units.zh: 從，疾，日行一度六分，二十三日行二十九度遲，日行二十分，八日行六度二十二分。
units.en: Prograde fast: 1 degree 6 parts per day, 23 days for 29 degrees; slow: twenty parts per day, 8 days for 6 degrees 22 parts.
units.literal: Prograde, fast, daily one degree six parts; in 23 days moves 29 degrees; slow, daily twenty parts; in 8 days moves 6 degrees 22 parts.

units.zh: 留，二日。
units.en: Stationary 2 days.
units.literal: Stationary, 2 days.

units.zh: 遲，日行十一分，二日退二十二分，夕伏西方。
units.en: Slow: eleven parts per day; 2 days, retreat 22 parts; evening concealment west.
units.literal: Slow, daily eleven parts; in 2 days retreats 22 parts; evening concealment in the west.

units.zh: 伏八日，退八度，而與日合。
units.en: Concealed 8 days, retreat 8 degrees, then conjunction.
units.literal: Concealed 8 days, retreats 8 degrees, then in conjunction with the sun.

units.zh: 又八日退八度，晨見東方。
units.en: Another 8 days retreat 8 degrees, then morning visibility east.
units.literal: Again 8 days retreat 8 degrees, morning appearance in the east.

units.zh: 逆，日行十一分，二日。
units.en: Retrograde eleven parts per day for 2 days.
units.literal: Retrograde, daily eleven parts; 2 days.

units.zh: 留，二日。
units.en: Stationary 2 days.
units.literal: Stationary, 2 days.

units.zh: 從，遲，日行二十分，八日。
units.en: Prograde, slow: twenty parts per day for 8 days.
units.literal: Prograde, slow, daily twenty parts; 8 days.

units.zh: 疾，日行一度六分，二十三日。
units.en: Fast: 1 degree 6 parts per day for 23 days.
units.literal: Fast, daily one degree six parts; 23 days.

units.zh: 晨伏東方，日度餘如初。
units.en: Morning concealment east; day and degree remainders as at first.
units.literal: Morning concealment in the east; day and degree remainder as at first.

units.zh: 一終百一十五日，日餘三萬四千七百三十九，行星如之。
units.en: One cycle: 115 days (remainder 34,739); motion matches.
units.literal: One cycle 115 days, day remainder 34,739; planetary motion the same.

units.zh: 一合五十七日，日餘三萬七千一百一十五，行星亦如之。
units.en: One conjunction: 57 days (remainder 37,115); motion likewise.
units.literal: One conjunction 57 days, day remainder 37,115; planetary motion likewise.

units.zh: 上元之歲，歲在甲子，天正甲子朔夜半冬至，日月五星聚於虛度之初，陰陽遲疾亦自此始。
units.en: At upper-origin year jiazi: civil new year jiazi new moon, winter solstice at midnight; sun, moon, and five planets at the start of Void; yin-yang and slow-fast sequences also begin here.
units.literal: In a year of the upper origin, the year is in jiazi; civil new year, jiazi new moon, midnight winter solstice; sun, moon, and five planets gather at the beginning of the lodge Void; yin-yang, slow-fast likewise begin from this.

units.zh: 梁武帝天監三年，沖之子恒上疏，論何承天歷乖謬不可用。
units.en: In Tianjian 3 (504), during the reign of Emperor Wu of Liang, Zu Chongzhi's son Heng memorialized that He Chengtian's calendar was erroneous and unusable.
units.literal: In the third year of Liang Emperor Wu's Tianjian reign, Chongzhi's son Heng submitted a memorial discussing the errors of He Chengtian's calendar, that it could not be used.

units.zh: 九年正月，詔用祖沖之所造《甲子元曆》頒朔。
units.en: In first month of year 9, an edict adopted Zu Chongzhi's Jiazi Epoch Calendar for issuing the new moon.
units.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, an edict ordered the Jiazi Epoch Calendar Chongzhi had made to be used to issue the new moon.

units.zh: 陳氏因梁，亦用祖沖之歷。
units.en: Chen continued Liang practice and used Chongzhi's calendar.
units.literal: Chen followed Liang and also used Chongzhi's calendar.

units.zh: 至遼，聖宗以賈俊所進新歷，因宋《大明》舊號行之。
units.en: Under Liao, Emperor Shengzong adopted Jia Jun's new calendar while retaining the Song name Great Brightness.
units.literal: Reaching Liao, Emperor Shengzong took the new calendar Jia Jun presented and, keeping the old Song title Great Brightness, put it into use.

units.zh: 金曰《重修大明曆》。
units.en: Jin titled it the Revised Great Brightness Calendar.
units.literal: Jin called it the Revised Great Brightness Calendar.

units.zh: 傳至皇元亦曰《重修大明曆》。
units.en: In the Yuan it was likewise the Revised Great Brightness Calendar.
units.literal: Transmitted to the Yuan it was also called the Revised Great Brightness Calendar.

units.zh: 及改《授時曆》，別立司天監存肄之，每歲甲子冬至重修其法。
units.en: After the Season-Granting Calendar replaced it, a Directorate of Astronomy kept the old methods, revised at each jiazi winter solstice.
units.literal: When the Season-Granting Calendar was adopted, a separate Directorate of Astronomy was established to preserve study; each jiazi year at winter solstice its methods were revised.

units.zh: 書在太史院，禁莫得聞。
units.en: The text remained in the Grand Astrologer's archive, barred from circulation.
units.literal: The book was kept in the Imperial Astronomical Archive; access was forbidden.

units.zh: 沖母，梁武帝妹新安穆公主，卒於齊世，武帝以沖偏孤，深所鍾愛。
units.en: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, a sister of Emperor Wu of Liang. She died in Qi times, and the emperor, seeing that Chong had been left partially orphaned, doted on him.
units.literal: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, sister of Emperor Wu of Liang; she died in Qi times, and the Emperor, because Chong was a lone orphan, cherished him deeply.

units.zh: 按梁武帝即位後，追尊其父為文皇帝。
units.en: After Liang Wudi's accession he honored his father posthumously as Emperor Wen.
units.literal: According to the note, after Emperor Wu of Liang took the throne he posthumously honored his father as Emperor Wen.

units.zh: 王沖傳言其母為梁武帝妹新安穆公主，與此合。
units.en: Wang Chong's biography says his mother was Liang Wudi's sister Princess Xin'an Mu, which matches.
units.literal: The biography of Wang Chong says his mother was Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess Xin'an Mu—this agrees.

units.zh: 王沖 王通弟勱 袁敬兄子樞
units.en: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu
units.literal: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu

units.zh: [2]琳，齊代娶梁武帝妹義興長公主，有子九人，嵭知名。
units.en: Lin, in Qi times, married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess of Yixing long; he had nine sons, all of whom won notice.
units.literal: Lin, in Qi times married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister Princess of Yixing long, had nine sons, and all became renowned.

units.zh: 大同末，梁武帝謁園陵，道出朱方，勱隨例迎候，队勱令從輦側，所經山川，莫不顧問，勱隨事應對，咸有故實。
units.en: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs by way of Zhufang; Mo met him as custom required. The emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; at every hill and stream he asked questions, and Mo answered each with historical precedent.
units.literal: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs; the route passed through Zhufang; Mo greeted him per custom; the Emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; every mountain and river passed, the Emperor inquired; Mo answered each matter with historical precedent.

units.zh: 八歲，讀沈約集，見回文研銘，從典援筆擬之，便有佳致。
units.en: At eight he read Shen Yue's collected works. Seeing a palindrome study inscription, Congdian took up the brush to match it and at once produced something fine.
units.literal: At eight he read Shen Yue's collected works; seeing a palindrome study inscription, Congdian took up the brush and imitated it, and at once achieved fine effect.

units.zh: 己丑，皇子隆緒生。
units.en: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.
units.literal: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.

units.zh: 穆宗下
units.en: Muzong, Part Two
units.literal: Muzong, Part Two

units.zh: 是夜，近侍小哥、盥人花哥、庖人辛古等六人反，帝遇弒，年三十九，廟號穆宗。
units.en: That night personal attendant Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and three others — six men in all — rose in revolt; the Emperor was assassinated at thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.
units.literal: That night attendants Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and three others — six men in all — rebelled; the Emperor met assassination at age thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.

units.zh: 贊曰：穆宗在位十八年，知女巫妖妄見誅，諭臣下濫刑切諫，非不明也。
units.en: The eulogy says: Muzong held the throne for eighteen years; he saw through the witch's fraud and had her killed, and he urgently warned his ministers against arbitrary punishments — he was not without understanding.
units.literal: The eulogy says: Muzong reigned eighteen years; he knew the witch's sorcery was false and had her executed, and he admonished his ministers against excessive punishment — he was not unintelligent.

units.zh: 癸亥，如潢河。
units.en: On guihai day the Emperor went to the Huang River.
units.literal: On guihai day he went to the Huang River.

units.zh: 十七年春正月庚寅朔，林牙蕭斡、郎君耶律賢適討烏古還，帝執其手，賜卮酒，授賢適右皮室詳穩。
units.en: In the seventeenth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first spring month, linya Xiao Wo and langjun Yelü Xianshi returned from suppressing the Wugu; the Emperor took Xianshi's hand, granted him a cup of wine, and made him right Pishi xiangwen.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first month of spring, linya Xiao Wo and langjun Yelü Xianshi returned from suppressing the Wugu; the Emperor took Xianshi's hand, granted him a cup of wine, and appointed him right Pishi xiangwen.

units.zh: 重熙二十一年，謚曰孝安敬正皇帝。
units.en: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi he was posthumously titled Emperor Xia'an Jingzheng.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi his posthumous title was Emperor Xia'an Jingzheng.

units.zh: 十四年春正月戊寅朔，奉安神纛。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, on the wuyin new moon of the first spring month, the spirit canopy was installed and enshrined.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, on the wuyin new moon of the first month of spring, the spirit canopy was installed and enshrined.

units.zh: 十五年春正月乙卯，以樞密使雅裏斯為行軍都統，虎軍詳穩楚思為行軍都監，益以突呂不部軍三百，合諸部兵討之。
units.en: In the fifteenth year, on yimao day in the first spring month, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Yalisi was made campaign commander-in-chief and Tiger Army xiangwen Chusi campaign deputy commander; three hundred Tulubu troops were added, and combined forces from the tribes were sent to suppress the rebellion.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, on yimao day of the first month of spring, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Yalisi was made campaign commander-in-chief and Tiger Army xiangwen Chusi was made campaign deputy commander; three hundred Tulubu troops were added, and forces from the various tribes were combined to suppress the rebels.

units.zh: 十六年春正月丁卯朔，被酒，不受賀。
units.en: In the sixteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor was drunk and refused congratulations.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first month of spring, he was drunk and declined congratulations.

units.zh: 十八年春正月乙酉朔，宴於宮中，不受賀。
units.en: In the eighteenth year, on the yiyou new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor held a banquet in the palace and declined congratulations.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year, on the yiyou new moon of the first month of spring, he held a banquet in the palace and declined congratulations.

units.zh: 十九年春正月乙卯朔，宴宮中，不受賀。
units.en: In the nineteenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, he feasted in the palace and refused the customary congratulations.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first month of spring, he held a banquet in the palace and did not accept congratulations.

units.zh: 己巳，如懷州，獵獲熊，歡飲方醉，馳還行宮。
units.en: On jisi day he went to Huai Prefecture, hunted down a bear, drank himself merry until he was drunk, then galloped back to the traveling palace.
units.literal: On jisi day he went to Huai Prefecture, hunted and captured a bear, drank joyfully until drunk, and galloped back to the mobile palace.

units.zh: 後附葬懷陵。
units.en: He was later buried by attachment at Huai Mausoleum.
units.literal: Later he was attached in burial at Huai Mausoleum.

units.zh: 而荒耽於酒，畋獵無厭。
units.en: Yet he gave himself over to drink and hunted without end.
units.literal: Yet he abandoned himself to wine and hunted without satiety.

units.zh: 賞罰無章，朝政不視，而嗜殺不已。
units.en: Reward and punishment followed no consistent rule; he ignored the business of government, yet his appetite for bloodshed never slackened.
units.literal: Rewards and punishments had no fixed rule; he would not look to court affairs, yet he never ceased killing.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔太尉化哥曰：「朕醉中處事有乖，無得曲從。
units.en: On yisi day he issued an edict to Grand Preceptor Huage: "When I decide matters in drunkenness and go wrong, you must not simply defer to me.
units.literal: On yisi day he issued an edict to Grand Preceptor Huage, saying, "When I handle affairs while drunk and go astray, you must not simply comply.

units.zh: 酒解，可覆奏。」
units.en: Once I am sober, you may submit the matter again."
units.literal: When the wine has cleared, you may resubmit your memorial."

units.zh: 六月丙午朔，獵於玉山，竟月忘返。
units.en: On the bingwu new moon of the sixth month he hunted at Jade Mountain and did not return for the entire month.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingwu new moon, he hunted at Jade Mountain and forgot to return for the whole month.

units.zh: 五月甲申，以歲旱，泛舟於池禱雨；
units.en: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, because the year was drought-stricken, he rowed a boat on a pool to pray for rain.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, because the year was drought-stricken, he rowed a boat on a pool to pray for rain.

units.zh: 不雨，舍舟立水中而禱，俄頃乃雨。
units.en: When no rain came, he left the boat, stood in the water to pray, and rain fell shortly afterward.
units.literal: When no rain came, he left the boat, stood in the water to pray, and rain fell shortly afterward.

units.zh: 六月己未，支解雉人壽哥、念古，殺鹿人四十四人。
units.en: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the pheasant-keepers Shouge and Nianggu were dismembered and forty-four deer-keepers were put to death.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the pheasant-keepers Shouge and Nianggu were dismembered and forty-four deer-keepers were killed.

units.zh: 戊辰，支解鹿人沒答、海裏等七人於野，封土識其地。
units.en: On wuchen day seven deer-keepers, including Moda and Haili, were dismembered in the open country, and mounds of earth were raised to mark the spot.
units.literal: On wuchen day the deer-keepers Moda, Haili, and five others were dismembered in the wild; earth was piled to mark the place.

units.zh: 三月癸酉，近侍東兒進匕箸不時，手刃刺之。
units.en: In the third month, on guiyou day, the attendant Dong'er presented chopsticks at the wrong moment, and the Emperor stabbed him to death with his own blade.
units.literal: In the third month, on guiyou day, the attendant Dong'er presented chopsticks at the wrong moment and was stabbed to death by the Emperor's own hand.

units.zh: 十二月辛未，手殺饔人海裏，復臠之。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, he personally killed the cook Haili and then butchered the corpse.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, he personally killed the cook Haili and then butchered the body.

units.zh: 己巳，如老林東濼。
units.en: On jisi day the Emperor went to Old Forest East Marsh.
units.literal: On jisi day he went to Old Forest East Marsh.

units.zh: 秋七月壬辰，以酒脯祀黑山。
units.en: That autumn, in the seventh month on renchen day, the Emperor sacrificed wine and dried meat to Black Mountain.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen day, wine and dried meat were used to sacrifice to Black Mountain.

units.zh: 丁未，還宮。
units.en: On dingwei day the Emperor returned to the palace.
units.literal: On dingwei day he returned to the palace.

units.zh: 乙卯，錄囚。
units.en: On yimao day the Emperor reviewed prisoners.
units.literal: On yimao day prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 上東幸，甲寅，以獲鴨，除鷹坊刺面、腰斬之刑，復其徭役。
units.en: The Emperor traveled east; on jiayin day, because ducks had been taken, the hawkery punishments of facial tattooing and waist-cutting were remitted and corvée duties were restored.
units.literal: The Emperor went east on a tour; on jiayin day, because ducks had been taken, the hawkery punishments of facial tattooing and waist-cutting were remitted and corvée duties were restored.

units.zh: 甲申，微行市中，賜酒家銀絹。
units.en: On jiashen day the Emperor walked incognito through the market and rewarded a wine shop with silver and silk.
units.literal: On jiashen day he walked incognito through the market and rewarded a wine shop with silver and silk.

units.zh: 三月己巳，東幸。
units.en: In the third month, on jisi day, the Emperor traveled east.
units.literal: In the third month, on jisi day, he went east on a tour.

units.zh: 秋七月壬午，諭有司：凡行幸之所，必高立標識，令民勿犯，違以死論。
units.en: That autumn, in the seventh month on renwu day, officials were instructed that wherever the Emperor traveled tall markers must be erected and the people forbidden to trespass, on pain of death.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu day, officials were instructed: wherever the Emperor traveled, tall markers must be erected and the people forbidden to trespass; violators were to be sentenced to death.

units.zh: 冬十月庚辰，漢主有母喪，遣使賻吊。
units.en: That winter, in the tenth month on gengchen day, the ruler of Han was in mourning for his mother, and the Emperor sent envoys with condolence gifts.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengchen day, the ruler of Han was in mourning for his mother, and envoys were sent with condolence gifts.

units.zh: 二月甲子，高勛奏宋將城益津關，請以偏師擾之，上從之。
units.en: In the second month, on jiazi day, Gao Xun reported that Song generals were fortifying Yijin Pass and asked that a flanking force be sent to harass them; the Emperor assented.
units.literal: In the second month, on jiazi day, Gao Xun memorialized that Song generals were fortifying Yijin Pass and asked that a flanking force be sent to harass them; the Emperor assented.

units.zh: 秋八月辛酉，生日，以政事令阿不底病亟，不受賀。
units.en: That autumn, in the eighth month on xinyou day, his birthday, because Chief Councillor Abudi was gravely ill, the Emperor declined congratulations.
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on xinyou day, his birthday, because Chief Councillor Abudi was gravely ill, he declined congratulations.

units.zh: 庚子，司天臺奏月當食不虧，上以為祥，歡飲達旦。
units.en: On gengzi day the Observatory reported that the moon should have been eclipsed but was not obscured; the Emperor took this as an auspicious sign and drank in celebration until dawn.
units.literal: On gengzi day the Observatory reported that the moon should have been eclipsed but was not obscured; the Emperor took this as an auspicious sign and rejoiced in drink until dawn.

units.zh: 己亥，觀燈於市。
units.en: On jihai day the Emperor viewed lanterns in the market.
units.literal: On jihai day he viewed lanterns in the market.

units.zh: 三月甲申朔，如潢河。
units.en: On the jiashen new moon of the third month the Emperor went to the Huang River.
units.literal: In the third month, on the jiashen new moon, he went to the Huang River.

units.zh: 乙酉，獲鴐鵝，祭天地。
units.en: On yiyou day swan-geese were taken and the Emperor sacrificed to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On yiyou day swan-geese were taken and heaven and earth were sacrificed to.

units.zh: 丙辰，司天監馬重績等進所撰新歷。
units.en: On the bingchen day, Ma Chongji of the Directorate of Astronomy and others presented the new calendar they had compiled.
units.literal: On the bingchen day, Ma Chongji of the Directorate of Astronomy and others presented the new calendar they had compiled.

units.zh: 降詔褒之，詔翰林學士承旨和凝制序，命之曰《調元曆》。
units.en: An edict praised them and ordered Hanlin expositor-in-chief He Ning to compose a preface; the calendar was named the 《Regulating the Origin Calendar》.
units.literal: An edict was issued praising them; the Hanlin expositor-in-chief He Ning was ordered to compose a preface, and the calendar was named the 《Regulating the Origin Calendar》.

units.zh: 五月乙亥，司天王白、李正等進歷。
units.en: On yihai day in the fifth month Astronomical Bureau director Wang Bai, Li Zheng, and others presented the calendar.
units.literal: On day yihai in the fifth month, Astronomical Bureau director Wang Bai, Li Zheng, and others presented the calendar.

units.zh: 芳又私撰歷書，名為《靈憲歷》，算月有頻大頻小，食必以朔，證據甚甄明，每云：「何承天亦為此法，不能精，靈憲若成，必當百代無異議。」
units.en: His private Spiritual Constitution Calendar tracked the moon’s varying size and fixed eclipses at new moon with rare clarity. “He Chengtian tried this but lacked precision,” he said; “finish this calendar and posterity will not quarrel.”
units.literal: Fang also privately drafted a calendar called the Spiritual Constitution Calendar, calculating that the moon is sometimes large and sometimes small and that eclipses must fall on new moon; the evidence was very clear. He often said, “He Chengtian also used this method but could not refine it; if the Spiritual Constitution is completed, for a hundred generations there will be no dispute.”

units.zh: 癸未，可汗州刺史賈俊進新歷。
units.en: On guiwei day Kehan Prefecture prefect Jia Jun presented a new calendar.
units.literal: On guiwei day Kehan Prefecture prefect Jia Jun presented a new calendar.

units.zh: 靈筵雖未升廟堂，而舫中即成行廟，猶如桓玄及宋高祖長沙、臨川二國，竝有移廟之禮。
units.en: Though the spirit-seat had not reached the temple, the barge itself served as a traveling shrine—as with Huan Xuan and, under Song Gaozu, the Changsha and Linchuan domains, which all observed temple-transfer rites.
units.literal: Though the spirit-seat had not yet ascended to the temple hall, on the boat it already formed a traveling temple, as when Huan Xuan and under Song Gaozu the states of Changsha and Linchuan both had the rite of moving the temple.

units.zh: 有司奏：「穆妃卒哭後，靈還在道，遇朔望，當須設祭不？」
units.en: The relevant offices submitted: "After Consort Mu completed the end of wailing, the spirit journey was still underway; should new- and full-moon offerings be held?"
units.literal: The relevant offices memorialized: "After Consort Mu's zui ku, the spirit-seat was still on the road; on new- and full-moon days, should offerings be set out or not?"

units.zh: 遼初用《乙未元曆》，本何承天《元嘉曆》法，後用《大明曆》，本祖沖之《甲子元曆》法。
units.en: The Liao first adopted the 《Yiwei Origin Calendar》, derived from He Chengtian's 《Yuanjia Calendar》, and later the 《Daming Calendar》, derived from Zu Chongzhi's 《Jiazi Origin Calendar》.
units.literal: At first Liao used the 《Yiwei Origin Calendar》, based on He Chengtian's 《Yuanjia Calendar》 method; later it used the 《Daming Calendar》, based on Zu Chongzhi's 《Jiazi Origin Calendar》 method.

units.zh: 沖之日食必朔，或四年一閏。
units.en: Zu Chongzhi insisted eclipses fall on the new moon and allowed an intercalary month as seldom as once in four years.
units.literal: Zu Chongzhi: solar eclipses necessarily on the new moon, sometimes one intercalation in four years.

units.zh: 〈（《契丹國志》引《紀異錄》云：契丹主德光常晝寢，夢一神人花冠美姿容，輜梅甚盛，忽自天而下，衣白衣，佩金帶，執钅骨钅朵，有異人十二隨其後，內一黑兔入德光懷而失之。
units.en: (The 《Khitan State Annals》 cites the 《Record of Strange Events》: The Khitan ruler Deguang often napped by day and dreamed of a divine man with a flowered crown and beautiful countenance, with a very splendid covered carriage, who suddenly descended from Heaven, wore white robes, bore a golden belt, and grasped a mace. Twelve strange men followed behind him, and among them a black rabbit entered Deguang's bosom and vanished.
units.literal: (The Khitan State Annals cites the Record of Strange Events: The Khitan ruler Deguang often napped by day and dreamed of a divine man with a flowered crown and beautiful countenance, with a very splendid covered carriage, who suddenly descended from Heaven, wore white robes, bore a golden belt, and grasped a mace; twelve strange men followed behind him, and among them a black rabbit entered Deguang's bosom and was lost.

units.zh: 神人語德光曰：「石郎使人喚汝，汝須去。」
units.en: The divine man said to Deguang: "Master Shi has sent men to summon you. You must go."
units.literal: The divine man said to Deguang: "Master Shi has sent men to summon you; you must go."

units.zh: 及重圍晉陽，帝遣心腹何福輕騎求援北蕃，蕃主自將諸部赴之。
units.en: When Jinyang was heavily besieged, the Emperor sent his trusted man He Fu with light cavalry to seek aid from the northern tribes. The Khitan ruler personally led his tribes to come.
units.literal: When Jinyang was heavily besieged, the Emperor sent his trusted man He Fu with light cavalry to seek aid from the northern barbarians; the barbarian ruler personally led the various tribes to come.

units.zh: 未浹旬，唐石敬瑭反於河東，為後唐張敬達所敗，亟遣趙瑩持表重賂，許割燕雲，求兵為援，契丹主曰：「我非為石郎興師，乃奉天帝敕使也。」）〉
units.en: Before ten days had passed, Tang's Shi Jingtang rebelled in Hedong, was defeated by Later Tang's Zhang Jingda, and urgently sent Zhao Ying with a memorial and heavy bribes, promising to cede Yan and Yun and seeking troops as aid. The Khitan ruler said, "I do not raise troops for Master Shi. I obey the Heavenly Emperor's command.".)〉
units.literal: Before ten days had passed, Tang's Shi Jingtang rebelled in Hedong, was defeated by Later Tang's Zhang Jingda, and urgently sent Zhao Ying with a memorial and heavy bribes, promising to cede Yan and Yun and seeking troops as aid; the Khitan ruler said, "I do not raise troops for Master Shi; I obey the Heavenly Emperor's command.".)〉

units.zh: 是日，帝言於契丹主，願以雁門已北及幽州之地為戎王壽，仍約歲輸帛三十萬，戎王許之。
units.en: That day the Emperor spoke to the Khitan ruler, offering the lands north of Yanmen and Youzhou as a gift for the Khitan ruler's longevity and agreeing to deliver three hundred thousand bolts of silk yearly. The Khitan ruler consented.
units.literal: That day the Emperor spoke to the Khitan ruler, wishing to give the lands north of Yanmen and Youzhou as a gift for the Rong king's longevity, and also agreed to deliver three hundred thousand bolts of silk yearly; the Rong king consented.

units.zh: 覺告其母，母忽之，不以為異。
units.en: When he awoke he told his mother. She dismissed it and did not regard it as strange.
units.literal: When he awoke he told his mother; his mother dismissed it and did not regard it as strange.

units.zh: 矧今中原無主，四海未寧，茫茫生民，若墜塗炭。
units.en: Moreover, now the central plains have no ruler, the four seas are not at peace, and the vast living people are as if falling into mud and fire.
units.literal: Moreover, now the central plains have no ruler, the four seas are not at peace, and the vast living people are as if falling into mud and fire.

units.zh: 況萬幾不可以暫廢，大寶不可以久虛，拯溺救焚，當在此日。
units.en: How much more may the myriad affairs of state not be briefly abandoned, nor the great treasure long left vacant. To rescue the drowning and save from burning must be done on this day.
units.literal: How much more may the myriad affairs not be briefly abandoned, nor the great treasure long left vacant—to rescue the drowning and save from burning must be on this day.

units.zh: 爾有庇民之德，格於上下；
units.en: You have the virtue of sheltering the people, reaching to above and below;
units.literal: You have the virtue of sheltering the people, reaching to above and below;

units.zh: 爾有戡難之勛，光於區宇；
units.en: you have the merit of quelling hardship, shining throughout the realm;
units.literal: you have the merit of quelling hardship, shining throughout the realm;

units.zh: 爾有無私之行，通乎神明；
units.en: you have selfless conduct, penetrating to the spirits;
units.literal: you have selfless conduct, penetrating to the spirits;

units.zh: 爾有不言之信，彰乎兆庶。
units.en: you have unspoken faithfulness, manifest among the myriad people.
units.literal: you have unspoken faithfulness, manifest among the myriad people.

units.zh: 予懋乃德，嘉乃丕績。
units.en: I exalt your virtue and praise your great achievements.
units.literal: I exalt your virtue and praise your great achievements.

units.zh: 天之歷數在爾躬，是用命爾，當踐皇極。
units.en: Heaven's succession rests on your person. Therefore I command you to ascend the imperial throne.
units.literal: Heaven's succession rests on your person; therefore I command you to ascend the imperial pinnacle.

units.zh: 仍以爾自茲並土，首建義旗，宜以國號曰晉。
units.en: Moreover, because you in Bing province first raised the banner of righteousness, the state name shall be Jin.
units.literal: Moreover, because you from this time in Bing province first raised the banner of righteousness, the state name should be called Jin.

units.zh: 朕永與為父子之邦，保山河之誓。
units.en: I shall forever be with you a realm bound as father and son, preserving the oath upon mountains and rivers.
units.literal: I shall forever be with you a realm of father and son, preserving the oath upon mountains and rivers.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 補百王之闕禮，行茲盛典；
units.en: Repair the deficient rites of the hundred kings and perform this great ceremony;
units.literal: Repair the deficient rites of the hundred kings and perform this great ceremony;

units.zh: 成千載之大義，遂我初心。
units.en: complete the great righteousness of a thousand ages and fulfill my original intent.
units.literal: complete the great righteousness of a thousand ages and fulfill my original intent.

units.zh: 爾其永保兆民，勉持一德，慎乃有位，允執厥中。
units.en: Forever preserve the myriad people, strive to hold to one virtue, be careful in your position, and truly hold fast to the center.
units.literal: You shall forever preserve the myriad people, strive to hold to one virtue, be careful in your position, and truly hold fast to the center.

units.zh: 亦惟無疆之休，其誡之哉！
units.en: May there also be boundless blessing. Take this as your warning!
units.literal: May there also be boundless blessing—take this as your warning!

units.zh: 禮畢，帝鼓吹道從而歸。
units.en: When the ceremony was complete, the Emperor returned with drums and pipes clearing the road before him.
units.literal: When the ceremony was complete, the Emperor returned with drums and pipes clearing the road before him.

units.zh: 謂福曰：「吾已兆於夢，皆上帝命我，非我意也。」
units.en: He said to Fu: "I have already been foretold in a dream. All of this is the Supreme Lord's command to me, not my own intent."
units.literal: He said to Fu: "I have already been foretold in a dream; all is the Supreme Lord's command to me, not my own intent."

units.zh: 母曰：「可命筮。」
units.en: His mother said: "You may order divination."
units.literal: His mother said: "You may order divination."

units.zh: 不以繒帛，不以珠金，若響應聲。
units.en: Without silks, without pearls and gold, he came like an echo answering a sound.
units.literal: Without silks, without pearls and gold, he came like an echo answering a sound.

units.zh: 及蕃軍大至，合勢破之，末帝之眾，似拉朽焉。
units.en: When the Khitan army arrived in great force and joined strength to break them, the Last Emperor's host collapsed like rotten wood pulled apart.
units.literal: When the barbarian army arrived in great force and joined strength to break them, the Last Emperor's host was like pulling rotten wood apart.

units.zh: 後復夢，即前神人也，衣冠儀貌，儼然如故，曰：「石郎已使人來喚汝。」
units.en: Later he dreamed again. It was the same divine man as before, robes, cap, bearing, and appearance all exactly as before, who said: "Master Shi has already sent men to summon you."
units.literal: Later he dreamed again—it was the same divine man as before, robes, cap, bearing, and appearance all exactly as before, who said: "Master Shi has already sent men to summon you."
